newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai group to privatise three electricity plants.
newsitem.headline: Thai group to privatise three electricity plants.

text.p: The state-owned Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) plans to privatise three of its electricity plants and list them on the stock market, EGAT's governor Preecha Chungwatana said on Tuesday.
Preecha said the plants, located in the provinces of Chonburi, Lampang and Ratchaburi, would be listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand by the 1998 fiscal year which starts on October 1, 1997.
Preecha's remarks were made after EGAT signed an agreement earlier in the day appointing Finance One Plc to be financial adviser on this privatisation scheme.
The total combined assets of the three plants are around 120 billion baht ($4.8 billion) and total production capacity is about 15,000 megawatts, EGAT said.
